title: Mootummaa dhumni abbaa biyyummaa osoo hin mul'atin itti hafe
intro: Seenaan bulchitoota gosa hundumaa beeka, garuu muraasni domeenii akka kanaa ajajan. Bakka qilleensi mataan isaa ajaja isaaniif deebii kennu fi hojjettoonni iji nama du’u kamiyyuu callisee dadhaban arguu hin dandeenyetti, bulchiinsi kun kan duraas ta’e booda ture kamiyyuu irraa adda ture. Ta’us mootummoonni gurguddoon illee xumuramuu qabu—inni kun yeroo xumuramus dhugaan sun madda gad of qabuu fi namni tokko illee shakkuuf hin yaadne irraa kan ba’e ture.
clues: Mootummaa bal’aa Gooftaa kootiin, kan fuula qulqulluu qaxxaamuree dubbatame naaf kenne.
Ogummaa fi aangoo guddaa warra of kennuudhaan na dura deeman irraan dhaale.
Qilleensa sana ajaje, innis kaayyoo kootiif fagoo deeme.
Uumamtoonni ija idileetiin hin mul’anne aangoo koo jalatti dhama’anii, dinqii wal bira qabamuu hin dandeenye ijaaran.
Burqaawwan sibiila diimaa baqfame naaf dhangala’e, eebba warra Rabbiin filate keessaa adda ta’e.
Yeroon addunyaa kanarraa bahu qaamni koo ulee tokkotti dhaabbatee hafe. Uumamni lafaa xiqqaan tokko ulee sana keessa yeroo nyaatu qofa namoonni naannoo koo jiran akkan darbe hubatan.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Jinni hanga uleen nyaatamutti hojii itti fufe
Sabni koo doonii guddaa tokko irra taa'ee fayye
Sabni jabaa tokko bubbee hamaadhaan diigame
Ani lubbuudhaan gara samiitti ol kaafame
outcome.answer: Jinni hanga uleen nyaatamutti hojii itti fufe

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
